scoring_justification: The main claim is about the qualitative shape and trends of three curves (stress-strain peak and flow plateau, mean yield stress increase then decrease, localization index peak and decay). Exact numeric agreement would depend on implementation details and parameter fitting; scoring structural trends ensures a correct reproduction is identifiable without relying on a digitized gold curve that could mismatch a valid implementation.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper figures 5 and 6 for GQ glass with rejuvenation
hidden_assets.generation_method: derived qualitative trends and approximate numeric ranges from paper and mesoscopic model scaling
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: trends are the central claim of the paper; numeric ranges are plausible based on the disclosed model parameters and atomistic stress units

outputs.description: Macroscopic stress-strain curve Sigma(gamma) for the GQ glass with rejuvenation. Scored by RMSE against hidden reference curve; lower RMSE is better.
Evolution of the spatially averaged local yield stress bar_sigma_c(gamma) for the GQ glass. Scored by RMSE and qualitative trend (initial increase, subsequent decrease) against hidden reference.
Localization index LOC(gamma) for the GQ glass. Scored by RMSE and qualitative check of peak and subsequent decay against hidden reference.

output_contract.notes: The three scored artifacts are produced by a single EPM simulation run; they are separated for scoring clarity. The hidden checker holds digitised reference curves from the paper and evaluates RMSE within tolerances, plus qualitative feature checks.

steps.description: Stress-strain curve: peak existence, post-peak trend, plateau range
Mean yield stress evolution: initial increase, subsequent decrease, start > end, max strain
Localization index: peak existence, decay, max value range
